name: add_text
author: hprebar
title: Add text
description: Places single-line text (DBText) or multi-line text (MText) at a position given in millimetres, with height in mm and rotation in degrees, optionally on an existing layer. Returns handle and the entity type created.

text.description: The text; MText accepts \\P for a line break

position.description: Insertion point in millimetres (bottom-left for DBText, top-left for MText)

layer.description: Existing layer name; default: the current layer

mtext.description: Create MText instead of single-line DBText

widthMm.description: MText only: wrapping width in millimetres (0 = no wrap)
